    Quotara · Words for every moment

    Privacy Policy

    Last updated: September 26, 2026

    Quotara is a free, static quote website operated by Quotara. This policy explains what information this website handles and what it does not collect. For privacy questions or requests, contact babarabdullah176@gmail.com.

    Information Quotara stores in your browser

    Quotara stores your liked-quote selections and your light/dark theme preference in your browser’s local storage. This information stays on your device and is not sent to Quotara’s server. You can remove it by clearing this site’s stored data in your browser settings.

    Information Quotara does not collect

    Quotara does not require an account and does not intentionally collect names, email addresses, passwords, payment information, location data, quote submissions, or private messages. The site does not use advertising trackers, analytics tools, or cookies for tracking.

    Third-party services and links

    The site may load fonts from Google Fonts, and your browser may connect to your email provider when you choose to leave a review. Those services operate under their own privacy policies. If Quotara is hosted on Netlify, Netlify may process technical request data such as your IP address and browser information in server logs under Netlify’s policies.

    Sharing

    If you use the Share Quotara control, your browser’s sharing feature or clipboard handles the action. Quotara does not receive a copy of what you share.

    Children

    Quotara is not directed at children under 13, and Quotara does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

    Changes to this policy

    If the site’s data practices change, this policy will be updated and the date above will change. Questions can be sent to babarabdullah176@gmail.com.

    Terms of Use

    Last updated: September 26, 2026

    Quotara is a free website for personal, inspirational, and informational use. By using it, you agree to use the site lawfully and respectfully.

    Use of the site

    You may read, copy, and share quotes for personal, non-commercial purposes. Do not use the site to distribute malware, interfere with its operation, scrape it abusively, or misrepresent Quotara as your own service.

    Content and attribution

    Quotes are provided for inspiration and may be incomplete, paraphrased, or attributed differently across sources. Quotara does not guarantee that every quote’s wording or attribution is historically accurate. Verify important quotations independently before publishing or relying on them.

    No professional advice

    Quote content is not medical, legal, financial, or professional advice. Make decisions based on appropriate qualified guidance.

    External services

    Links to email, sharing tools, and other external services are provided for convenience. Quotara is not responsible for the availability, content, or policies of external services.

    Availability and changes

    The site is provided as-is and may be changed, paused, or removed without notice. Quotara does not sell products, process payments, or create user accounts at this time.

    Contact

    Questions about these terms can be sent to babarabdullah176@gmail.com.
